witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W1 store inventory balance with LAGGED arrivals; W2 AGGREGATE warehouse outbound capacity conditioned on depot activation; W3 non-negative inventory; W4 non-negative shipments; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE route and depot costs (tol 1e-6); W6 activation: warehouse-period ships >0 iff depot flag==1.

c7_lag.description: C7 time-alignment error: arrivals credited same-period instead of next-period (transit lag dropped). Type-legal, feasible, cheaper; true lagged balance violated.

c7_c5_compound.description: Compound injection: lag dropped AND aggregate cap written per-route. Two errors in one artifact; tests multi-error detection.

b7_rewritten.description: Benign rewrite: t != 1 instead of t > 1, semantically identical. Must PASS; false-alarm control.

c8_sign.description: C8 sign error: demand ADDED instead of subtracted in the inventory balance. Feasible, plausible-looking; witness balance with true sign violated.

c4_offbyone.description: C4 off-by-one: balance subtracts NEXT period's demand (last period clamped). Type-legal; witness balance with true demand violated.

c5_scope.description: C5 quantifier-scope error: aggregate warehouse cap written per-route. Type-legal, looser, cheaper; true aggregate capacity violated.

c5_drop.description: Omission: the capacity constraint block is missing entirely (not miswritten — absent). Witness aggregate cap violated.

b5_commute.description: Benign rewrite: inequality commuted (cap >= sum). Semantically identical. Must PASS; false-alarm control.

c3_no_link.description: C3 activation error: ship-to-depot-flag link dropped; optimizer keeps y=0 everywhere, pays no depot cost. Feasible, cheaper; violates activation rule.

c6_map.description: C6 entity-mapping error: W1's routes charged at W2's unit costs. Constraints untouched; reported objective mismatches recomputed true cost -> W5.
